content: True revolution is the psychological revolution of the individual.
author: Jiddu Krishnamurti
explanation:
In this illuminating teaching from The Only Revolution, Jiddu Krishnamurti directs our attention away from the restless turbulence of external seeking to the unshakeable foundation within. When we get caught in mental chatter, social anxiety, and habitual reactivity, we forget the underlying silence that sustains our awareness. By contemplating revolution, we dissolve the illusion of separateness and discover a profound clarity that transforms everyday life.

True wisdom is not something to be acquired like a new possession; it is the natural fragrance of a mind that has learned to be still. When you align your daily conduct with this understanding, you move through the world with unshakeable grace, freedom, and deep peace.
practicalInsight: Practice conscious revolution today. Whenever you feel pulled into mental restlessness, pause and anchor yourself in quiet presence.
reflectionPrompt: How can greater awareness of revolution dissolve the primary stress or doubt in your mind today?
